svg.desc: and: sift 5.52x, sift (positions off) 5.55x, pg_textsearch 0.03x, rum 1.03x, pgx-bm25 0.03x, Elasticsearch 2.26x; or: sift 2.43x, sift (positions off) 2.34x, pg_textsearch 2.51x, rum 0.01x, pgx-bm25 0.04x, Elasticsearch 1.83x; phrase: sift 5.07x, sift (positions off) 1.27x, pg_textsearch 0.04x, rum 0.03x, pgx-bm25 0.02x, Elasticsearch 2.71x; mixed: sift 3.63x, sift (positions off) 2.29x, pg_textsearch 0.05x, rum 0.02x, pgx-bm25 0.03x, Elasticsearch 2.31x; count(*): sift 6.81x, sift (positions off) 1.55x, pg_textsearch 0.06x, rum 0.04x, pgx-bm25 0.02x, Elasticsearch 3.91x; filter: sift 3.22x, sift (positions off) 2.73x, pg_textsearch 0.05x, rum 0.03x, pgx-bm25 0.03x, Elasticsearch 2.04x; join: sift 7.50x, sift (positions off) 4.80x, pg_textsearch 0.22x, rum 0.12x, pgx-bm25 0.13x, Elasticsearch 13.73x
svg.text: queries per second divided by pg_search, higher is better
Error bars: one standard error over the interleaved rounds (rough for 2-3); red: relative error above 10%.
Elasticsearch: a JVM server over HTTP; its join is a term filter on a denormalized region field.
Simple English Wikipedia, 50,000 articles, 8 clients, median of 2-3 rounds; AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads (load avg 7-9); Oct 2026.
